name: Scylla Musume
source:
The ruler of Dungeon 2.

Shy and timid. After fleeing from stalker-like men, she gained the permission of the previous Dragon King and now lives quietly in the castle.

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid3/charactor04.html]Official website[/url]]
